prerequisites: Codex CLI for Git plugin provisioning
script:
set -eu
git config --local maintenance.autoDetach false
git config --local gc.autoDetach false
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
vida_bun_pin=$(tr -d "\r\n" < packages/agent/.bun-version)
if ! command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ "$(bun --version)" != "$vida_bun_pin" ]; then
  vida_bun_stage=$(mktemp -d)
  vida_bun_release="https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v$vida_bun_pin"
  curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 2 --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 180 "$vida_bun_release/SHASUMS256.txt" -o "$vida_bun_stage/SHASUMS256.txt"
  curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 2 --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 180 "$vida_bun_release/bun-linux-x64.zip" -o "$vida_bun_stage/bun-linux-x64.zip"
  (cd "$vida_bun_stage" && sha256sum --check --ignore-missing SHASUMS256.txt)
  unzip -q "$vida_bun_stage/bun-linux-x64.zip" -d "$vida_bun_stage"
  test "$("$vida_bun_stage/bun-linux-x64/bun" --version)" = "$vida_bun_pin"
  mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
  install -m 755 "$vida_bun_stage/bun-linux-x64/bun" "$HOME/.local/bin/bun.vida-$$"
  mv -f "$HOME/.local/bin/bun.vida-$$" "$HOME/.local/bin/bun"
  test "$(bun --version)" = "$vida_bun_pin"
  rm -- "$vida_bun_stage/SHASUMS256.txt" "$vida_bun_stage/bun-linux-x64.zip" "$vida_bun_stage/bun-linux-x64/bun"
  rmdir -- "$vida_bun_stage/bun-linux-x64" "$vida_bun_stage"
fi
bun tooling/agent/cloud-tooling-setup.ts
. "$HOME/.cache/vida-cloud-tooling/environment.sh"
bun tooling/agent/cloud-pstack-setup.ts --install --provision-only
bunBootstrap: Read the version from packages/agent/.bun-version; verify the Linux x64 archive against that official release's SHASUMS256.txt before atomic installation. A matching Bun skips download.
pluginTrust: Verify the native enabled trusted SessionStart hook. New or changed hook trust requires native /hooks review; setup reports GAP without a bypass.
configurationSaveStatus: requires supported host configuration editor; not saved by runtime-status API

runtimeEnvironmentRecommendations.TMPDIR: disk-backed path emitted by environment.sh; apply as runtime variable if startup exports do not persist
runtimeEnvironmentRecommendations.VIDA_VEX_CPU: first allowed CPU emitted by environment.sh; use taskset for Vex

memoryPolicy: Keep retained existing tmpfs evidence; future scratch on disk. Cold semantic index is lead-owned, separate from install, and must pass before semantic readiness is claimed.
optionalIndexPreparation: bun tooling/agent/cloud-tooling-setup.ts --prepare-index (separate from install, after static checks; requires 6 GiB cgroup headroom)

resourceRecommendations.memory: A clean 16-GiB host may suffice with disk-backed scratch; retaining current ~12-GiB tmpfs data plus model/compiler requires additional headroom. Adjust in provider editor if available; no quota change is applied here.
resourceRecommendations.concurrency: One cold semantic build; do not overlap with compilers/coverage or other model jobs.
